template_data.headline_html: Five GSA pricing traps that lock in your losses.

items.title: Basis of Award anchor
items.desc: Discount privately later — GSA may claim that same rate. Price with the clause in mind.

items.title: Price Reduction Clause
items.desc: Every better deal offered anywhere else can trigger a matching obligation to the government.

items.title: Vague unit pricing
items.desc: "Discounted from catalog" stalls approval. COs need auditable unit rates, not approximations.

items.title: No escalation clause
items.desc: Without Economic Price Adjustment, year-3 costs run at year-1 rates. Build the ramp in now.
